title: Flipkart Products Scraper
description: Scrape public Flipkart product search result data including title, price, rating, reviews, specs, image, and product URL. Defaults are set for a low-cost iPhone price test.

searchQueries.title: Search Queries
searchQueries.description: Product search terms such as iphone, laptop, shoes, or mixer grinder.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum products to save across all search queries. Start with 10 to keep usage low.

sortBy.title: Sort By
sortBy.description: Optional Flipkart sort order for search results.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Flipkart commonly blocks datacenter traffic, so residential India proxy is enabled by default for reliable cloud runs. Proxy traffic may be billed as platform usage.
